execution.description: Reconciled the Graphite admission handoff against main, PR 498, PR 504 and the step 4 branch, and searched the shared admission, agent-campaign and value code for battery-only literals.

The capability registry is per-Challenge data, which is where it belongs. None of these modules had a test with a second Challenge, so the literals went unnoticed.
keep: Reconcile against exact commits and branch heads before building.
Keep each Challenge's specifics in its own record or adapter, as the capability registry does.
change: Give every shared module a test with a synthetic second Challenge from its first commit.
Move the remaining literals (allowlists, query set, compiler dispatch) to per-Challenge records as each module is next touched.
